author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices steady beat, high and low, loud and soft, and taking turns, using the old clapping game grown-ups and children share.

classes.title: Sway with the baker
classes.goal: Hear the whole clapping song and sway and clap to its beat together.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling a beat that comes again and again, evenly

classes.parentPrompt: Sit face to face, sway together, and clap your hands on each beat.
classes.childAction: Sway, then clap your hands with the song.
classes.bridge: The beat is the baker patting dough: pat, pat, pat, always even.

intro.caption: Let's be bakers!
intro.parentCue: sit face to face and sway together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the steady beat, together.

classes.title: Pat the dough
classes.goal: Pat one steady tap on each beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One pat for each beat, no more and no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and pat together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Pat any key with a flat hand on every beat.
classes.bridge: The keys are soft dough: a flat hand pats it on every beat.

intro.caption: Flat hands, pat the dough
intro.parentCue: pat your lap first, then the keys

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one pat for each beat.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the matching side of the piano.

mathTarget.parentLine: Low sounds live on the left, high sounds on the right

classes.parentPrompt: Growl and crouch for the bear; flap your arms and reach up for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear sound: tap the left side. Bird sound: tap the right.
classes.bridge: The bear's big paws pat low on the left; the bird pecks high.

intro.caption: The bear lives low, the bird flies high
intro.parentCue: point left for the bear, right for the bird

games.caption: Here comes the bear
games.parentCue: Growl softly, then pat low together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low sounds.

classes.title: Big pats, tiny pats
classes.goal: Pat the beat with big loud pats, then with tiny soft pats.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same pat can be big or small

classes.parentPrompt: Use strong arms for loud pats; whisper and use fingertips for soft.
classes.childAction: Loud: big baker pats. Soft: tiny fingertip pats.
classes.bridge: Loud pats flatten the dough; soft pats are a feather on the cake.

intro.caption: Big pats, tiny pats
intro.parentCue: loud means strong arms, never banging

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Bake it fast, bake it slow
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows like a turtle and speeds like a bunny.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same tune, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Pat your child's knees slowly, then quickly, matching the music.
classes.childAction: Turtle music: slow pats. Bunny music: quick pats.
classes.bridge: As fast as you can: bunny pats are quick, turtle pats are slow.

intro.caption: Bake it as fast as you can
intro.parentCue: slow down if the pats get wild

games.caption: Bunny bakes fast!
games.parentCue: Same tune, now quick and light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Into the oven, freeze!
classes.goal: Pat while the music plays and hold still when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: When the music stops, freeze with hands up like a cake waiting to bake.
classes.childAction: Pat while the music plays. Freeze when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, we pat the dough; music off, the cake sits still.

intro.caption: Pat, pat... freeze!
intro.parentCue: make freezing silly, like a statue

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: Guess the music game
classes.goal: Listen and switch between games: high and low, loud and soft, slow and fast.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: high or low, loud or soft?

classes.parentPrompt: Before each picture, ask: bear or bird? Loud or soft? Cheer every guess.
classes.childAction: Guess the game, then pat high, low, loud, soft, slow or fast.
classes.bridge: Every sound dresses up: bear, bird, big pat, tiny pat, turtle or bunny.

intro.caption: Which game is it?
intro.parentCue: let your child guess first; every guess counts

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling sounds apart and switching games.

classes.title: Baby and me
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together into one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Pat the beat on any key while your grown-up plays.
classes.bridge: Two bakers, one cake: you pat the beat, I play the tune.

intro.caption: I play, you pat
intro.parentCue: sit side by side at the piano

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: A cake for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song from the first note to the last, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on, and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the tune, then clap, cheer and bow together.
classes.childAction: Pat the beat to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: The song bakes the cake; the last note pops it in the oven.

intro.caption: A song for teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
